sourceAudio: User-supplied 最終鬼畜妹フランドール・S 320k MP3
method: Video audio is used only to locate the arcade edit. All output samples come from the supplied clean MP3. Band-limited (150-4000 Hz) 1 s waveform correlation gives four constant offsets whose differences are 9.6 s, 48.0 s and 9.6 s (8, 40 and 8 bars at 200 BPM); 50 ms correlation places each cut on a beat at source 28.7875 s, 77.3875 s and 144.5875 s. The recording's own fade matches the MP3's natural ending, so no extra fade is applied. This is a reconstruction of the arcade edit, not an official audio file.
